notes.title: In Silence Waits is an upcoming modern take on classic graphical adventures
notes.content:
Older readers might be interested in this one. Silent Shoals Software announced In Silence Waits, a modern take on classic graphical adventures.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/07/in-silence-waits-is-an-upcoming-modern-take-on-classic-graphical-adventures/
